name: prompt-gate
description: Before the main model spends a turn on a vague prompt, a small model, checked by Jev when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, says so and asks one short question. Default mode dry only measures. With a key set, the prompt goes to api.typesafe.ai (Jev) from every directory unless jevPaths limits it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, dry (classify and log only, nothing is blocked), flag (a vague prompt enters with a note for the main model to ask you) or on (a vague prompt is bounced with one question).

model.title: Classifier model
model.description: The small model that judges each prompt.

minChars.title: Minimum length
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are not judged.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: auto uses Jev, then Haiku when unsure, if TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set (the prompt and, if enabled, the project vocabulary go to api.typesafe.ai); haiku never contacts Jev; jev lets Jev decide and Haiku only write the question.

jevPaths.title: Jev directories
jevPaths.description: Comma-separated directory prefixes (~ allowed). Jev is used only when the session runs in or under one; empty means anywhere; a non-blank value with no usable entry means nowhere.

projectTerms.title: Project terms
projectTerms.description: yes gives the classifier the start of the project's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md as vocabulary; no does not.
